# Gaps (generated)

Generated by `npm run verify` from the rule ledger and the verdict. The hand-written
account of divergences is `GAPS.md`.

- PRO-01: failing, 574 of 577 fixtures pass. Changing a subscription item credits the unused time of the old item as a negative line: minus the old unit amount times the old quantity times remaining time over period length. The credit carries the discount in force on the credited period, a used once coupon included.
- PRO-02: failing, 575 of 578 fixtures pass. It charges the remaining time on the new item as a positive line: new unit amount times new quantity times remaining time over period length.
- PRO-03: failing, 572 of 575 fixtures pass. Proration is computed to the second from proration_date to the end of the current period.
- PRO-04: failing, 578 of 585 fixtures pass. Proration lines are rounded to the cent: credits round half away from zero, the classic-mode charge rounds half up, and the flexible-mode charge behaves like rounding of a floating-point 1 - elapsed/period (7.5 and 22.5 down, 1501.5 up).
- PRO-05: failing, 595 of 598 fixtures pass. Without an immediate invoice, the preview is the next renewal invoice: prorations plus the next full period at the new price and quantity.
- PRO-08: failing, 223 of 224 fixtures pass. A quantity change prorates like a price change: credit at the old quantity, charge at the new quantity.
- PER-01: failing, 105 of 106 fixtures pass. A monthly period runs to the same day of the next calendar month, so the period length in seconds depends on the month.
- INT-01: failing, 52 of 56 fixtures pass. Interval changes. Flexible mode: monthly to yearly prorates the yearly price over the remaining time and keeps the anchor; yearly to monthly keeps the anchor while the proration date is inside the new monthly period and is rejected past it. Classic mode: an interval change resets the billing cycle to the clock time. Yearly to yearly keeps the period.
- DSC-01: failing, 232 of 236 fixtures pass. A percent-off coupon takes round(percent × sum) from the discountable lines it applies to and allocates that amount across them like an amount-off: floor of the proportional share, with the remainder one cent per line from the last line. This includes the first invoice, whose allocation sets the discount a flexible credit carries.
- DSC-02: failing, 260 of 267 fixtures pass. In flexible billing mode, the discount is applied inside proration lines (proration_discounts=included) instead of at invoice level.
- DSC-03: failing, 233 of 239 fixtures pass. An amount-off coupon is allocated across discountable lines in proportion to their amounts, with rounding.
- DSC-05: failing, 118 of 122 fixtures pass. A once coupon on the subscription discounts its first invoice only. A once coupon passed to the preview: (a) with prorations and no immediate invoice, discounts only the remaining-time charge and is not listed in the invoice's discounts; (b) when the change prorates nothing, discounts the renewal invoice and is listed; (c) in an immediate invoice, is listed in discounts and total_discount_amounts at 0 and on the proration lines at 0.
- MOD-01: failing, 192 of 193 fixtures pass. Classic and flexible modes differ by the order of prorating and discounting (DSC-02, DSC-04), which can move a line by one cent, by the credit line's discount list for a used once coupon, and by the cycle reset on an interval change in classic mode.
- LIF-03: not covered by a fixture; behaviour inferred from https://docs.stripe.com/billing/subscriptions/cancel; unverified.
- LIF-04: not covered by a fixture; behaviour inferred from https://docs.stripe.com/billing/subscriptions/cancel; unverified.
- ITM-01: failing, 176 of 179 fixtures pass. With several items, a change to one item prorates that item only: the other items produce neither credit nor charge lines in the preview's proration, and recur at their own amounts.
- DSC-06: failing, 75 of 76 fixtures pass. Two coupons on a subscription both apply to its discountable lines, each reported in total_discount_amounts.
- DSC-08: failing, 18 of 19 fixtures pass. Flexible mode: a discount carried by a credit line whose prorated amount rounds to 0 is not applied: it is absent from the line's description and, in an immediate invoice, from its discount list. Classic mode keeps the label.
- INT-02: failing, 10 of 11 fixtures pass. An interval change with proration_date at the current period end still changes the subscription. Flexible: a remaining-time charge from proration_date to the new, start-anchored period end, then the renewal. Classic: the cycle resets and the invoice bills a full new period from the clock time. A credit with zero remaining time is omitted.
- INV-01: failing, 5 of 6 fixtures pass. An invoice whose amount due is above 0 and below the minimum charge is not charged: amount_due 0, status paid, and the amount is added to the customer balance. The next invoice shows it as starting_balance and adds it to amount_due. In test mode in USD the minimum is 56 cents: the dev-t2-f probes leave 1 to 55 cents uncharged and charge 56 and above.
